summary: Completed testing of WatchNexus new dashboard features (Continue Watching, Next Up) and Library Settings with Sonarr-like Media Management UI. All 22 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly. Fixed bug in WatchProgress model where user_id was required instead of optional.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: WatchProgress model user_id field changed from required to Optional[str] = None (server sets it from authenticated user)
Dashboard correctly shows Continue Watching section with progress bars, time remaining, and episode info for TV shows
Dashboard correctly shows Next Up section for TV shows with next episode suggestions
Library Settings has 5 working sub-tabs: Libraries, Media Management, Quality Profiles, Mass Editor, Manual Import
Media Management sub-tab has Sonarr-like Episode Naming with format templates and preview
Quality Profiles sub-tab shows 3 preset profiles (Any, HD-720p/1080p, Ultra-HD) with Edit/Delete buttons
Mass Editor sub-tab shows series list with Title, Status (Ended/Continuing), and Monitored columns
Documentation files exist: THEME-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md (726 lines), GADGETS-GUIDE.md (171 lines), USER-GUIDE.md (380 lines)
seed_data_creation: Created watch progress entries for Fight Club (movie), Breaking Bad (TV S1E3), House of the Dragon (TV S1E5) to test Continue Watching and Next Up sections
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard now shows Continue Watching and Next Up sections when user has watch progress data. Library Settings at /settings has 5 sub-tabs with Sonarr-like Media Management UI. Auth with test@test.com / password.
